name: Trees
summary: Answer the question for a node in terms of the answers for its children. Define what each recursive call returns, handle the empty case, then combine.
signal: recursive parent-child structure, depth, diameter, lowest common ancestor
mentalModel: If I already knew left and right, what is current? Then solve left, solve right, combine.
recognitionRules: The data has a parent-child structure: binary tree, n-ary tree, trie.
The question can be asked recursively: max, sum, depth, diameter.
You need an ancestor of two nodes, or the lowest common one.
You need a traversal that visits children before or after the parent.
The answer is defined bottom-up from the leaves.
invariant: Every recursive call returns the correct value for its own subtree, so the parent only has to combine.
